title: Your Truck Is Nine Years Old
kidsText: Your old truck still runs. Keep it, buy a used one, or get a new one?
adultText: The old one still runs, but the new ones have heated seats. Keep it, pay cash for a used one, or finance new?

options.label: Keep the old truck
options.kidsText: Keep driving it. It still works.

options.label: Buy a used truck for cash
options.kidsText: Pay $4,000 cash for a used one.
options.adultText: A three-year-old truck, paid in full. No monthly payment.

options.label: Finance a new truck
options.kidsText: Take a loan. Pay $380 every month.
options.adultText: The dealer's loan: 12,000 at 380 a month. Heated seats included.

title: Family Beach Week
kidsText: A week at the beach for the whole family. Go, or stay home this year?
adultText: Seven nights, four people, one rented house by the ocean. Memories are not a monthly bill, but the trip is.

options.label: Stay home this year
options.kidsText: Stay home and keep the money.
options.adultText: A week of day trips instead. Nothing changes.

options.label: Book the beach house
options.adultText: Pay 2,500 in cash for the week.

title: Big Screen and Sound System
kidsText: A giant TV and big speakers. Keep your old TV, pay cash, or pay a little each month?
adultText: Wall-sized television and speakers you can feel. The store offers no-money-down financing.

options.label: Keep the old TV
options.kidsText: Your old TV still works. Keep it.

options.label: Pay cash
options.adultText: Pay 1,800 in cash. No monthly payment.

options.label: Finance it
options.kidsText: Pay $90 every month for a long time.
options.adultText: No money down, 90 a month on 1,800 of principal.

title: Streaming Bundle
kidsText: Four streaming apps in one bundle for $60 a month. Sign up, or skip it?
adultText: Four streaming services in one bundle, 60 a month, cancel any time. Will you?

options.label: Skip it
options.kidsText: Skip it and keep your money.

options.label: Subscribe for 60 a month
options.kidsText: Pay $60 every month until you cancel.
options.adultText: A subscription liability of 60 a month. REPAY cancels it at no cost.

title: Tax Refund
kidsText: A $2,000 tax refund! Spend it, invest it, or pay off debt?
adultText: A 2,000 refund lands in your account. Spend it, invest it in an index fund, or pay down your most expensive loan?

options.label: Spend it
options.adultText: A shopping weekend. The 2,000 is gone by Monday.

options.label: Invest it in an index fund
options.kidsText: Put the $2,000 in an index fund. It grows every month.
options.adultText: Index fund: grows 4 percent a month and pays out 1 percent of its value each Payday.

options.label: Pay down your biggest loan
options.kidsText: Pay $2,000 toward your loan with the biggest payment.
options.adultText: Pays up to 2,000 toward the loan with the highest monthly payment. Mortgages are not loans here.
